name: dates-full-date-needs-an-exact-match
description: Prefix matching only widens a month-year in the response. "March 2026" (2026-03) equals the evidence date "March 2026": known. "March 15, 2026" normalizes to 2026-03-15, and a full response date needs the same full date in the reference; the reference has only the month 2026-03: fires on it.

input.response: The beta opens in March 2026, on March 15, 2026 exactly.
